# Workload Balancing

`customer_support.support_operations.workload_balancing` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**Who should be working what right now, and who is quietly carrying this queue?**


> Deciding who works what, given that agents are not interchangeable units of capacity. An even split of ticket count across an uneven split of difficulty is not balance — it is a slow queue and a quietly resentful team — so the load being balanced is open work in progress and skill match, not throughput. The hard part is the specialist: routing everything difficult to the one person who can do it optimises this week and manufactures a single point of failure, which is why some deliberately inefficient assignment is the price of a team that still functions when that person is on leave.
